headlines.title: AI chip boom pushes Samsung profits to record $80bn
headlines.description: The tech giant is also expected to get a boost from its latest folding devices that were launched in August.

headlines.title: Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
headlines.description: Asahi, Sapporo, Kirin and Suntory confirmed to the BBC that their premises had been searched by the Japanese competition authority.

headlines.title: Boots sold in £7bn deal to Canadian billionaire family
headlines.description: The sale of the High Street chain was announced on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Ex-bankers jailed for rigging rates have convictions quashed
headlines.description: Jay Merchant, Jonathan Mathew, Philippe Moryoussef, Alex Pabon, Colin Bermingham had their convictions overturned by the Court of Appeal.

headlines.title: Royal Mail plans to cut 2,500 jobs
headlines.description: The postal service firm wants to cut head office and other non-frontline jobs by the end of 2027.
